evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries forceful urgency to purge — high arousal, negative valence directed at erasure.
Command to 'Remove all knowledge' extends the same urgent erasure directive — activated-negative arousal sustained across consecutive imperatives.
Flat declarative closing the sequence — low arousal, negative valence; a resigned corrective statement delivered without urgency.
